description: OHLCV candles for indicator/momentum strategies (RSI, moving averages, breakouts) — resolve_symbol first to get the coinId. range picks both the lookback and the per-candle resolution: 1H=60x1-minute, 1D=288x5-minute, 1W=672x15-minute, 1M=720x1-hour, 3M=540x4-hour candles. Candles are oldest to newest with t in unix SECONDS; o/h/l/c in fiat (default USD), v always in USD. These are sampled composite-price bars, not venue trade candles. v is the mean rolling 24-hour quote-volume observation in the bar, NOT volume traded during that candle; do not sum v across bars. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

coinId.description: Coin UCID (e.g. "1" = BTC). Use resolve_symbol to find it.
